key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran conflict lifting oil prices and long-term Treasury yields
reasoning: The U.S.-Iran conflict has materially escalated to a ninth consecutive night of strikes, Brent above $90, slowing Hormuz shipping, and a confirmed U.S. service-member death, while oil-driven inflation pressure has pushed the 30-year Treasury yield above 5%. This high-severity escalation outweighs earnings anticipation because the bullish AI items are expectations or preliminary talks, whereas the geopolitical and rates shock is active and unresolved.
